features.title: Unstoppable fury
features.text: Rage fuels heavy weapon hits and grants temporary hit points. It limits concentration, but no longer reduces Armor Class by itself.

features.title: Follow your instinct
features.text: Your instinct shapes your powers and tactics. Choose between a direct damage routine and feats that add movement, maneuvers or supernatural abilities.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 5 → 5. Rage and martial scaling support exceptional sustained single-target damage.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3–4. Large HP, resistances and instinct choices shape durability; base Rage no longer penalizes AC.
ratings.support: 2 → 1.5–3. Athletics and control feats help allies; damage alone is counted under offense.
ratings.utility: 2 → 2. Athletics and survival skills help, but the class adds few general noncombat tools.
ratings.difficulty: 1 → 1.5–2.5. The basic attack loop is direct; instinct restrictions and maneuver builds add decisions.
